I added the tests, but I couldn't run them. Every Bash call failed because the sandbox needs `socat`, which isn't installed. So I haven't confirmed that the new tests fail on the base commit for the right reason, and I haven't run the full suite.

The ten tests are in a new class `TestAttrListEmptyList` at the end of `tests/test_syntax/extensions/test_attr_list.py`. The design says to put them in the existing attr_list test class. I added a new class because the existing ones don't fit, and it sets `default_kwargs` to `attr_list` like the neighbouring class.
